topicName: Matrix Builds and Dynamic Strategy Generation
content:
[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Matrix Builds and Dynamic Strategy Generation in GitHub Actions"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"GitHub Actions matrix builds allow you to run your workflows across multiple operating systems, programming language versions, and configurations simultaneously. By leveraging dynamic strategy generation, you can programmatically define these matrices at runtime using outputs from previous jobs."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Basic Matrix Builds"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"A standard matrix is defined inside the 'strategy' key of a job. It generates a separate job execution for every possible combination of the specified variables."},{"order":5,"type":"code","text":"name: Basic Matrix
on: [push]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node: [16, 18, 20]
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Use Node.js \${{ matrix.node }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: \${{ matrix.node }}"},{"order":6,"type":"subheading","text":"Dynamic Matrix Generation"},{"order":7,"type":"paragraph","text":"Sometimes static configurations are not enough. You might need to determine your build matrix dynamically based on repository contents, pull request files, or external API responses. You can achieve this by having a setup job output a JSON string that is subsequently consumed by a dependent job's strategy."},{"order":8,"type":"code","text":"name: Dynamic Matrix
on: [push]
jobs:
  generate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: \${{ steps.set-matrix.outputs.matrix }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - id: set-matrix
        run: |
          # Dynamically determine directories or targets
          JSON="[\"pkg-a\", \"pkg-b\", \"pkg-c\"]"
          echo "matrix=$JSON" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
  build:
    needs: generate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        package: \${{ fromJson(needs.generate.outputs.matrix) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Build package
        run: echo "Building \${{ matrix.package }}""},{"order":9,"type":"subheading","text":"Best Practices"},{"order":10,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Use 'fail-fast: false' in your strategy if you want other matrix combinations to continue running even if one fails."},{"order":11,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Always validate that dynamically generated JSON arrays are properly formatted and escaped before writing them to '$GITHUB_OUTPUT'."},{"order":12,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Be mindful of GitHub Actions concurrency limits and available runners when generating extremely large dynamic matrices."}]
